zh.title: 阿拉斯加航空擬2027年開航巴黎與雅典季節性航線
zh.summary: 阿拉斯加航空擴展西雅圖航線；預計2027年直飛巴黎與雅典；與達美航空競爭
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，阿拉斯加航空計劃於2027年推出飛往巴黎與雅典的季節性直飛航班。這項開航計畫將為該航空公司新增兩個歐洲季節性直飛航點。
阿拉斯加航空將巴黎與雅典納入航線網路後，其與達美航空在西雅圖的航線競爭將擴展至五條歐洲航線。兩家航空公司在西雅圖樞紐的航線佈局呈現競爭態勢。
根據報導，相關新航班預計於2027年正式啟動營運，使阿拉斯加航空在歐洲航線的營運選擇增至五種方式。

en.title: Alaska Airlines Plans Seasonal Nonstop Flights to Paris and Athens in 2027
en.summary: Alaska Airlines plans seasonal flights to Paris and Athens in 2027, expanding competition with Delta.
body: Alaska Airlines plans to launch seasonal nonstop flights to Paris and Athens in 2027, according to a report by Simple Flying. The expansion will add two new European destinations to the carrier's route offerings.

The addition of Paris and Athens comes as Alaska Airlines expands its competition with Delta Air Lines in Seattle across five European routes. The launch will broaden non-stop travel options for passengers.
With these new services planned for 2027, Alaska Airlines will offer five ways to Europe from Seattle, expanding its route network and market presence alongside rival carrier Delta Air Lines.
